summary: Official Andhra Pradesh cadastral/land-record evidence was found. Bhuvan's current JavaScript/configuration and WMS capabilities were inspected and its Andhra Pradesh cadastral layer was exercised anonymously. The exact-point feature-info response was empty and a bounded WMS map returned raster only; no safe native parcel identity plus full polygon geometry was obtained, so runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Telugu discovery queries, exact text and actual result URLs are recorded in city-10925-bhimavaram.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET retrieved the official Bhuvan Andhra Pradesh state viewer HTML, its current state_uncomp_06072018.js configuration, and the Bhuvan WMS GetCapabilities document. The configuration uses OpenLayers and identifies public WMS/GetFeatureInfo routes. GetCapabilities for https://bhuvan-vec1.nrsc.gov.in/bhuvan/gwc/service/wms/ returned HTTP 200; the layer cadastral:AndhraPradesh__Cad_sisdp_p2 was listed as queryable with EPSG:4326. A direct WMS GetMap request to https://bhuvan-vec1.nrsc.gov.in/bhuvan/wms/ for BBOX=81.50,16.52,81.55,16.57 returned HTTP 200 PNG raster imagery. The equivalent GWC GetMap request was attempted and returned HTTP 400 because the requested horizontal resolution exceeded the configured scale threshold. GetFeatureInfo against the same layer and a 0.05-degree extent at the exact WUP point returned HTTP 200 FeatureCollection with zero features; this is not treated as a citywide hit/miss result. A direct GET to https://bhunaksha.ap.gov.in/ timed out after 30 seconds; no login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception was used.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: TLS-verified GET timed out after 30 seconds; official existence and purpose were independently evidenced by Andhra Pradesh NIC and search discovery.

attemptedRoutes.route: ISRO NRSC Bhuvan Andhra Pradesh state viewer
attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200; official state viewer lists Bhimavaram and a Cadastral layer. Current HTML and JavaScript were retrieved.
HTTP 200; cadastral:AndhraPradesh__Cad_sisdp_p2 listed queryable with EPSG:4326. Capabilities expose layer metadata, not full parcel geometry.
HTTP 200 PNG for bounded BBOX 81.50,16.52,81.55,16.57 using cadastral:AndhraPradesh__Cad_sisdp_p2; raster only, not retained.
HTTP 400 for the bounded request because GWC rejected the requested horizontal resolution as outside its configured scale threshold.

attemptedRoutes.route: Bhuvan WMS GetFeatureInfo at exact WUP point
attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 FeatureCollection, zero features for the exact-point pixel. No inference of citywide absence.
HTTP 200 official Bhimavaram ULB portal; links municipal property-tax and mutation services, but no public parcel vector response was retrieved.
HTTP 200 official AP NIC prose documents WebLand, Bhunaksha, LPM and ULPIN concepts; general state-agency context, not a Bhimavaram parcel response.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [16.5429339362058,81.5268143253089] was preserved; the zero GetFeatureInfo response is not evidence of citywide absence.
The tested WMS extent is a bounded 0.05-degree area and is not evidence of complete Bhimavaram municipal coverage.
The returned WMS response was raster imagery; no full parcel polygon was retrieved or retained.
The WMS capabilities layer name is source metadata, not proof that native parcel IDs are exposed in an anonymous safe response.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion records research status only; it does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter. Independent serial review remains required.
